# SEARCH source-boundary evidence

This directory contains frozen DATA fixtures. Python generators and donor copies have been removed; the retained data, checksums and oracle outputs are preserved byte for byte. TypeScript tests continue to compare against these expectations.

The historical module paths, SHA-256 values and Git revisions are recorded in the [fixture origin index](../../../README-fixtures.md). Existing provenance inventories retain their historical Python entries; they are not a current checkout file list.

The historical `sources/generate.py` used Python 3.12. The independent supplement records 31 complete donor outcomes
for required catalogue status, source identifier and programme-field hashability,
and scalar controls. Direct and compiled CLI tests compare complete groups in
raw and accepted modes.

The original 65 scenarios, donor corpus, reference and wrapper evidence, Unicode
tables and all eleven evidence pins remain unchanged. The original README is
part of that pinned evidence; supplemental documentation belongs in this folder.
